title: Human-approved P0 catalog, roadmap, and planning-evidence wave
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 5, 2026 approval to execute the five highest-priority OpenFS tasks. Verify the production deployment of PR #47; apply the structured catalog-detail layout to ARCH-01, ARCH-04, SSW-05, APP-02, and CROSS-08; strengthen layout completeness validation; publish the eight remaining P0 roadmap families in a common evidence-backed provisional format; and improve public planning evidence for center facilities and operations, procurement and five-year cost, EEA1 reproducibility, and conversion of application demand into system requirements. All outputs must remain public-information-only, provisional, single-model, and Consensus-incomplete. Unknown timing, cost breakdowns, measurements, and acceptance thresholds must remain Coverage Gaps rather than inferred facts. This directive does not authorize procurement, technology adoption, unattended publication, or merging a Pull Request.
